about.description01: I'm Marc Zamora, a designer and developer from Barcelona, now based in Mataró. I create digital experiences where visual character and usability work together.
about.description02: My work spans UX/UI, product design and frontend development — from shaping ideas and designing interfaces to building them. I care about clarity, detail and how things actually feel to use.
about.description03: I like good ideas, straightforward collaboration and, preferably, good coffee. Have something in mind? Let's talk.
